content.short: UXUY is a multi-chain trading platform and wallet that enables native asset swaps via the Multi-chain Pipe.
content.description:
UXUY is a leading decentralized multi-chain trading protocol and self-custodial wallet, incubated by Binance Labs and designed to solve the complexity of cross-chain asset management. The platform features the proprietary "Multi-chain Pipe" protocol, which enables near-instant swaps using native assets across various networks—including Ethereum, BNB Chain, and TON—without the security risks associated with wrapped tokens. UXUY is deeply integrated with the Telegram ecosystem, providing a seamless gateway for millions of social users to interact with DeFi.

The platform also features a unique "GasLess" protocol, allowing participants to execute trades without holding native gas tokens on every network. UXUY focuses on professional-grade performance and high throughput, serving as a primary venue for asset discovery and liquidity bootstrapping. Through its commitment to user-centric design and technological innovation, UXUY is building the essential framework for a more unified and accessible global digital economy, where cross-chain trading is as intuitive as a traditional mobile application.
content.meta: UXUY offers high-speed multi-chain trading and a GasLess wallet experience across major blockchain networks.
